(Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium comprising__ water; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __at least one__ enzyme.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of__ genotyping.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __a genotypic analysis of the obtained DNA__.
